ideas.pitch: Automated security sandbox and network packet inspector for validating web and API pentesting flags without leaking environment secrets.
ideas.problem_statement: Web Application Pentesting and API Pentesting challenge validation security
ideas.title: CTFFence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core infrastructure needs of a CTF by providing secure, isolated testing environments inspired by real-world network attack simulations.

ideas.pitch: An automated intelligence-gathering pipeline that correlates social media footprints, DNS histories, and exposed API keys into an interactive graph.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT and Digital Forensics challenge automation
ideas.title: OSINT-Chain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent pipelines to automate tedious intelligence gathering, ensuring a polished live demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid memory forensics assistant that parses raw RAM dumps for injected DLLs, hidden processes, and cryptographic keys using heuristic pattern matching.
ideas.title: MemDump-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a notoriously time-consuming forensics problem with high-performance parsing and clear visual summaries, meeting the bar for genuinely hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic cipher identifier and attack-vector runner for weak RSA, custom XOR schemes, and broken padding oracles.
ideas.title: CryptoBreaker-X
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an instant toolkit for tackling complex math and implementation flaws during a high-pressure 24-hour CTF window.

ideas.pitch: Real-time API schema validator and automated fuzzer that detects broken object level authorization (BOLA) and parameter tampering flaws.
ideas.title: API-Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on modern API attack surfaces which are often heavily weighted in contemporary security competitions.
